manifest: EXTERNAL REFERENCE RUNTIMES USED AS VALIDATION ORACLES
purpose: Three of the four modern comparators have their maintained reference implementation in a language this project does not run. Each was executed inside a pinned container so the comparison is reproducible and so no external toolchain was installed into a Git-controlled path.
why_containers: the native R and Octave installers require UAC elevation that a non-interactive session cannot grant (winget reported 'You cancelled the installation' / 0x800704c7). Containers removed the dependency on an elevated shell entirely.

runtimes.added_for: the dependency set of the author's DCSI code path

runtimes.role: MATLAB-compatible runtime for the author's CVDD .m sources

author_sources.policy: fetched to a temporary scratch checkout OUTSIDE the repository, mounted read-only, never committed

entries.relationship: oracle only -- no source copied, vendored or translated; no author data committed

reproduction.prerequisite: the author checkouts must be present in the scratch directory; the containers must be built or pulled. Both live outside this repository by design.
